title: Emergency Codes
description: Fill-in templates for family safe words, phone codes hidden in normal conversation, and duress codes, plus home, vehicle, and meeting-point signals, whistle patterns, and written shorthand. Covers verifying identity, codes children can remember, and building a family code card.
